```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(SimPlot)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

#### simulate data for examples
```{r}
set.seed(1212)
sim_data = data.frame(contin_var1 = rnorm(n = 30)) |>
  mutate(contin_var2 = rnorm(n = 30, mean = 0.8*contin_var1, sd = 1)) |>
  mutate(cat_var1 = rbinom(n = 30, size = 1, prob = plogis(0.8*contin_var1))) |>
  mutate(cat_var1 = ifelse(cat_var1 == 0, "cat a", "cat b") |> as.factor()) |>
  mutate(cat_var2 = rbinom(n = 30, size = 1, prob = plogis(-0.5*contin_var1))) |>
  mutate(cat_var2 = ifelse(cat_var2 == 0, "cat c", "cat d") |> as.factor()) |>
  mutate(count_var1 = rpois(n = 30, lambda = exp(1.0*contin_var1))) |>
  mutate(count_var2 = rpois(n = 30, lambda = exp(-1.0*contin_var1))) |>
  mutate(k = 10)
```

#### fit models for examples
```{r}
contin_model = lm(contin_var2 ~ contin_var1 + cat_var1 + count_var1, data = sim_data)
cat_model = glm(cat_var2 ~ contin_var1 + cat_var1 + count_var1, family = "binomial", data = sim_data)
count_model = glm(count_var2 ~ contin_var1 + cat_var1 + count_var1, family = "poisson", data = sim_data)
```

## y is continuous

#### marginal plot of continuous y
```{r}
sim_plot(contin_model)
```

#### continuous predictor, continuous y
```{r}
sim_plot(contin_model, pred = "contin_var1")
```

#### cat predictor, continuous y
```{r}
sim_plot(contin_model, pred = "cat_var1")
```

#### count predictor, continuous y
```{r}
sim_plot(contin_model, predictor = "count_var1")
```

## y is categorical

#### marginal plot of categorical y
```{r}
sim_plot(cat_model)
```

#### continuous predictor, categorical y
```{r}
sim_plot(cat_model, pred = "contin_var1")
```

#### cat predictor, categorical y
```{r}
sim_plot(cat_model, pred = "cat_var1")
```

#### count predictor, categorical y
```{r}
sim_plot(cat_model, predictor = "count_var1")
```

## y is count data

#### marginal plot of count y
```{r}
sim_plot(count_model)
```

#### continuous predictor, count y
```{r}
sim_plot(count_model, pred = "contin_var1")
```

#### cat predictor, count y
```{r}
sim_plot(count_model, pred = "cat_var1")
```

#### count predictor, count y
```{r}
sim_plot(count_model, predictor = "count_var1")
```
